The irreducible quartic inward-branch polynomial has an exact abstract positive pure interval law;positivity and normalization alone cannot exclude all interior branches.
METHOD-GRAPH-HULL-BALAYAGE-20261115.boundary: Single-domain topology and exact sweeping are internally proved on both full thin architectures. Pole-compatible fixed-curve density classes are closed only when the representation and differential pole condition are actually proved.
